scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/remote-protocol build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/remote-protocol build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs
